mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 6% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening in monetary policy and accelerating inflation, increasing uncertainty and risk premiums, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A strong positive correlation between monthly HOUST (housing starts) and INDPRO over the past six months signals synchronized growth in construction and manufacturing, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST and INDPRO are strongly correlated over the prior six months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in PAYEMS of more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month +0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during three consecutive months of >0.5% monthly PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in RSAFS (retail sales) of more than 3% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue for consumer-facing corporations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, except during periods of strong monetary easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls by more than 3% YoY and monetary policy is not easing.
